selected_pin_arrangement: Four individual M339 pins: two low-speed and two track, following the explicit SNL137 application line.
unresolved_alternative: HB207 and SNL251 give two total. Two shared long pins remain a possible earlier arrangement; applicability to the first-100 production configuration is unresolved.
interpretation: M337 upper clevis and tapered transverse stock are hidden-geometry estimates consistent with a pivot around the saved M338 lug. No recovered transverse section exists.

Lower eyes use a common interface station behind the larger track band, leaving room for the future rear bracket and its lining fasteners. This is a mechanical layout hypothesis, not a source dimension.

Source quarter-inch by1-1/2 inch split-pin stock controls the nominal folded envelope and leg centerline length. Two round legs and their eye are an explicit cross-section/form approximation; no exact physical stock volume claim.
HB134/135 source overlays retain the inherited channel/shaft registration disagreement. Do not move source datums or inherited frame geometry to conceal it.
